envelope.description: Move the commit-and-push callers and the remaining wrapper callers

body.title: Move the commit-and-push callers and the remaining wrapper callers
body.summary: Move questions.ts commitAndComment, resolve-comment.ts commitRecorded and handleResolveComment, team/signoff.ts:385, config/github.ts gitOriginOwnerRepo uses, tracker-auto.ts ghAuthOk and attach.ts onto the registry forms; ordinary git failures stay logged, a ToolDenied is rethrown and stops the stage, handleResolveComment returns its error result with the recorded count.
acceptanceChecks: a denied commit posts no comment and handleResolveComment returns the error result, never success
ordinary git failures are still logged and the stage continues
tracker-auto reads the {ok, reason} result unchanged

tests.name: commit-denial-callers.test.ts: a denied commit posts no comment and handleResolveComment returns the error result; ordinary git failures are logged and the stage continues
attach-tracked-check.test.ts: a tracked file passes and an untracked file is refused with the old reason
registry-denial.test.ts: no-client, declined, timed-out and cancelled approval deny a moved call and later calls are not made
